name: [Portal] API access credentials contract: read OAuth client and regenerate secret
description:
### Summary

The Partner Portal will replace the legacy „API Partner → Access to API" tab (`/admin/api-partner/?action=oauth`), which shows the partner's OAuth Client ID, a masked Client secret (last 5 characters), the two OAuth server URLs and lets the partner reveal the full secret or regenerate it after re-entering their admin password. Today that data is assembled inline in `ApiPartnerController::buildOauthProps()` from the `Partners` helper and written through the 2000-line `Shoptet\Connectors\Model\ApiPartner` model. There is no reusable contract. This task adds one to `cms/packages/PartnerPortal/Application/Contracts/`, following the existing `PartnerAccountReadRepositoryInterface` pattern: a read contract returning the credentials DTO (masked by default, full secret on explicit request) and a write contract regenerating the client secret. The password re-check stays with the calling controller. Result: the new portal screens under  get their data by constructor injection, exactly like `PartnerPortalOverviewController`.

### Why?

The portal's Addons screens need the same credentials the legacy tab shows, and the only way to get them today is to copy controller code or call the `ApiPartner` god-model directly. Both duplicate the secret-masking rule (hard-coded to 5 chars in PHP and again in `OauthView.tsx`) and the string-concatenated OAuth URLs. A contract owned by DevRel gives one definition. The code being wrapped (`ApiPartnerController`, `ApiPartner` model, `Partners` helper) is unowned in CODEOWNERS, so new code in `cms/packages/PartnerPortal` is the only path with a clear owner.

### What?

- A read contract in `Application/Contracts/` returning a DTO with: client ID, masked secret, full secret (only when the caller explicitly asks), OAuth authorize URL, OAuth access-token URL, plus the CRM API token for internal partner projects (it sits on the same tab, see Q1).
- A write contract regenerating the client secret for the current project's partner, returning the new secret.
- Defined behaviour for the two legitimate empty states: project has no partner, or partner has no `oauth_clients` row.
- Non-goal: no UI change and no change to the legacy `ApiPartnerController` or its tab. This task delivers the contract only; switching the legacy tab to the contract is a possible follow-up.

### Acceptance Criteria

Read contract interface + DTO live in 

cms/packages/PartnerPortal/Application/Contracts/

, implementation in 

Infrastructure/

, registered in 

config/app/partner-portal-services.neon

Masked secret is derived inside the contract (single constant), never by the caller

Full secret is returned only when the caller passes an explicit reveal flag; the default call never contains it

Write contract regenerates the secret via the existing generator (

shoasecret_

 + 64 hex) and returns the new value; a missing 

oauth_clients

 row raises a domain exception instead of silently returning false

Both OAuth URLs are built inside the contract from the project URL, not concatenated by callers

No partner / no OAuth client row → documented result (nullable DTO or dedicated exception), covered by tests

Unit tests for DTO mapping and masking; integration test against 

st_cms.oauth_clients

 regenerating and reading back the secret

Legacy tab behaviour unchanged (no diff under 

admin/controllers/ApiPartnerController.php

); 

make phpstan-l10

 clean for new files; 

make tests-architecture

 passes

### Open questions

- Q1: Is the CRM API token in scope for the same DTO, or a separate contract? It only exists for internal partner projects (`PartnerProjectService`).

### Resources

- Feature epic: 
- Legacy tab: [https://363432.myshoptet.com/admin/api-partner/?action=oauth](https://363432.myshoptet.com/admin/api-partner/?action=oauth)
- Rewrite record with the full legacy behaviour: `docs/tpl-to-react/rewrites/ApiPartner.md`
- Existing DevRel contract to mirror: `cms/packages/PartnerPortal/Application/Contracts/Account/PartnerAccountReadRepositoryInterface.php`

### Technical notes

Repository facts established 2026-09-29 (origin/master):

- Current assembly: `admin/controllers/ApiPartnerController.php:454-479` (`buildOauthProps`, masking `substr(-5)` at :467, URLs at :470-471), regenerate action :424-442, password gate `isAccessedByCorrectUserPassword()` :731 (POST only, depends on admin-layer `SecretProvider` + `AdminUserHelper`, so it stays in the controller).
- Storage: `st_cms.oauth_clients` (`database/schema/st_cms.sql:1751`), joined to `st_api.partner` by `api_partner_id`. Global silo, not per-project. Secret stored plaintext and read back verbatim, so the DTO carries a live credential.
- Read today: `cms/packages/Miscellaneous/Helper/Partners.php:567-578`. Write: `cms/packages/Connectors/Model/ApiPartner.php:416` (`regenerateOAuthClientSecret`, returns affected-row bool that the caller ignores), generator :1930, prefix constant :73. A thin repository over `oauth_clients` is the clean seam; do not absorb the model.
- Consumer shape: `admin/controllers/PartnerPortal/PartnerPortalOverviewController.php` (invokable, constructor injection, no QueryBus).
- Legacy React view: `frontend/apps/admin-web/src/Core/pages/ApiPartner/views/oauthView/OauthView.tsx` (`MASKED_SECRET_CHARS = 5`). No Cypress coverage of the tab; PHPUnit coverage in `tests/unit/admin/controllers/ApiPartnerControllerTest.php:281-352`.
- No CQRS contract for this domain exists in `cms/packages/Contracts/` (nearest: PartnerApiHealth, Partnership, Marketplaces/Authorization, all different domains). Greenfield.
